stories.title: The Bastine Road: Young Warrior
stories.summary: Return the listed trophy to King Mrotha for his Young Warrior commission. The King describes an ordered campaign, but each exchange accepts its trophy independently. Gifts are accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a dirk called 'intimidator'
steps.hint: The thief captain on the Breale trade route carries the intimidator. A valid trophy supplied by another player also works.

steps.text: Present a dirk called 'intimidator' to King Mrotha
steps.hint: Find the King at his throne. This exchange awards 20 gold. His next commission asks for an iron crown of King Vinzor.

stories.title: The Werewolf Prince
stories.summary: Bring the Prince Prisoner's bloody werewolf head to King Mrotha for the werewolf-hide leggings. Explore the castle's concealed history to understand the King's reaction. A supplied head is accepted.

steps.text: Carry the tower key
steps.hint: The key and a note to Phex are in the desk beneath the King's bedroom passage. The key opens the locked door at the top of the tower stairs reached from the south guard quarters.

steps.text: Carry 1 x the bloody head of a werewolf
steps.hint: The Prince Prisoner carries this head in the locked tower. The journal records its delivery; it does not establish who defeated the prince.

steps.text: Bring the werewolf head to King Mrotha
steps.hint: The King supplies werewolf-hide leggings. His grief and disease warning are part of the response; this checklist does not record infection, a cure or a temporary banishment.

stories.title: The Apprentice's Trust
stories.summary: Earn Victor's trust with Sir Lamerok's signet ring. He supplies a small steel key and the apprentice's ring for Morlanthra's rescue in Esterra's Cavern. That later rescue belongs to the surrounding lands.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a shiny signet ring
steps.hint: Sir Lamerok carries the shiny signet ring in Esterra's Cavern. Identification reveals his name. A supplied valid ring is also accepted.

steps.text: Present Lamerok's ring to Victor
steps.hint: Victor is in Morlanthra's bedroom. His steel key opens Esterra's room; Esterra carries the plain iron key, and Nynevena the transparent key. A separate tree-shaped key opens the prison. Give the apprentice's ring to Morlanthra for his own rescue reward.

introduction: Answer King Mrotha's call for adventure, investigate the hidden prince, or help Victor reach his imprisoned master.
orientation: Ask the King about knight, then yes to hear his first commission. His twelve trophy requests form a narrated road to knighthood; each can be completed independently.
Victor offers a separate rescue lead involving Sir Lamerok, Esterra's keys and Morlanthra. His trust reward starts that route; it does not complete the later rescue.
The checklist records supplies and accepted exchanges. Claimed ranks, personal kills, discovered clues and opened locks need their own evidence before becoming earned stages.

contacts.name: King Mrotha
contacts.description: Ask about knight, no or yes for the invitation and reply. Return the specific trophies for independent commissions.

contacts.name: Victor the Apprentice
contacts.description: Ask about morlanthra to learn why Victor needs Lamerok's signet ring. His reward supplies the next rescue leads.
